CILRES CIL ZONE: Higher Rate - RATE: £120 per square metre

description: Works to one Scotch Pine tree covered by TPO no.7 (1957) - fell to ground level.
decision_conditions: This consent is valid for two years.Reason: In order that the nature of work pertaining to this consent remains appropriate.

Pursuant to the removal of the Scots pine tree hereby approved, the Local Planning Authority require that one Scots pine tree of 'standard' size be planted in accordance with arboricultural good practice.  The replacement tree shall be planted in the first planting season [November to March] or part thereof following the commencement of works on site, as close to the removed tree as is practical.  If, within a period of five years of planting, the replacement tree dies, it shall be replaced with one of similar size and type.  The Local Planning Authority shall be informed in writing once the replacement tree has been planted.Reason: In the interests of visual amenity in accordance with section 206 of the Town and Country Planning Act (1990) following the removal of preserved tree[s] and to maintain the Borough's stock of amenity trees.

The attention of the applicant is drawn to the provisions of the Wildlife and Countryside Act [1981] where the approved tree work[s] have the potential to interfere with or disturb breeding birds or mammals.Reason: In order to ensure compliance with current legislation protecting wildlife.
